howPoints.title: How points work
howPoints.body: Each battle you win scores its kill points. Every objective your team meets in that battle adds its score, and clearing all enemies adds the defeat-all bonus. A battle only counts once at its best: replaying it scores only the points above your previous high score.

howPoints.title: How points work
howPoints.body: Each battle's earned points are its kill score plus its high score, plus the defeat-all bonus and the score of every objective you cleared in it. A battle's maximum adds its full kill score, its full high score, the defeat-all bonus and every objective's score; the lane maximum adds every battle.

active.title: The running event
active.content: The Legendary Event that is live right now, with its run, tokens and points from your last sync. Select it to open the event.

noActive.title: Nothing running
noActive.content: No Legendary Event is live right now. Upcoming events below show when the next run starts.

upcoming.title: Upcoming events
upcoming.content: Events that start next, soonest first, with their local start time. Events without an announced date are listed last.

tabs.title: Overview and lanes
tabs.content: Overview sums up the event; Alpha, Beta and Gamma open one lane each. On a phone the strip stays under the header while you scroll.

nextToken.title: Next token
nextToken.content: The battle to play with your next token: the team, lane and battle worth the most points now, from your sync, teams, depths and marks. If it didn't go to plan, mark it Partly cleared or Couldn't clear and the plan updates.

runStatus.title: Run status
runStatus.content: Your run, tokens, points, currency in hand, chests and shards from your last sync, plus the next points milestone.

runInputs.title: Run inputs
runInputs.content: Tick the missions you finish in each run and set how many you plan to complete, plus the packs the game does not report. They feed the reward outlook on this card, and open missions point the Next token at battles that progress them.

tokenPlan.title: Token plan
tokenPlan.content: Every token the plan expects to play in order, with running points and the milestones it crosses. The run forecast below spreads it across the remaining runs.

laneSummary.title: Lane summary
laneSummary.content: Each lane's points earned against its maximum and how many battles you have fully cleared. Pick a lane to jump to its progress grid.

overviewLeaderboard.title: Eligibility across lanes
overviewLeaderboard.content: Every unit that can play, with the points it can still score in each lane. Filter by objective, show only unlocked units, or switch to points per battle.

laneOverview.title: Lane overview
laneOverview.content: The lane's allowed units, kill points and five objectives with their scores, then a map of how far your roster can get: each battle's defeat-all and objectives as cleared, reached by your teams, within your roster's reach, or out of reach.

teams.title: Teams
teams.content: Build the teams you plan to play on this lane. Each card shows its members, the objectives they cover, how deep it should clear and the points it has left up to that battle: an estimate from your synced roster until you set a depth yourself. Use Add team to start one. Suggest teams proposes teams from your roster, ranked by the points they add.

upgradeImpact.title: Upgrade impact
upgradeImpact.content: Which single upgrade earns you points on this lane: each row names the battle it lets a team reach and the points it adds. Create a goal for it in one tap.

progressGrid.title: Synced progress
progressGrid.content: Your cleared objectives and points per battle from your last sync, with the lane's points earned against its maximum. Mark an objective you have not cleared as Maybe clear or Stop here, or a whole battle from its row action.

battles.title: Battles
battles.content: Preview any battle of the lane before you play it: its map, its waves round by round and every enemy with its level. Tap an enemy for its stats. It opens on your next battle to play.

leaderboard.title: Lane leaderboard
leaderboard.content: Every unit this lane allows, whether you own it, which objectives it meets and the points it can still score here. Turn on Goals Preview to see units as if your active goals were reached, and use a row's menu for Create goal or Add to new team.

lastRun.title: Last run
lastRun.content: How your previous run went: each lane's deepest battle and points, the teams you used and how far they got, and what changed on those units since.

controls.title: Controls
controls.content: Choose the events, which units to list, how points are counted, and search by name. The view stays in the link, so you can share it.

events.title: Events
events.content: Pick the events to compare. Active and upcoming events are selected first; archived events sit below the divider.

pointsMode.title: Points mode
pointsMode.content: Remaining leaves out what you already scored, All counts every battle, and Estimated counts only the battles you are expected to clear.

firstRow.title: Units
firstRow.content: Each unit's total across the selected events, with its points and objectives (or teams) per event. Click an event header to sort by it.

row.title: Tier rows
row.content: Each row is a horde-mode tier with its multiplier. Characters are ordered from the highest multiplier down.

tile.title: A character
tile.content: The portrait, name and multiplier. A marked multiplier is the character's own rather than its tier's. Select the tile for its details and a link to the Library.

filters.title: Filters
filters.content: Search by name, show only the characters you own, or pick an alliance. The filters apply to every row, Untiered included.

estimates.uncalibrated: Uncalibrated: the estimate's power ratio has not been fitted to real clears yet, so treat it as a rough guide.
estimates.howItWorks: Estimated from your synced roster's power, equipment included, against each battle's power. Synergy and hard objectives aren't modelled; set a depth to override it.

goalsPreview.hint: Shows units as if your active goals were reached. Points and teams don't change.
goalsPreview.noGoals: No active goals for this event's units
goalsPreview.noRoster: Sync your roster to preview goals

upgradeImpact.title: Upgrade impact
upgradeImpact.hint: What one next step of a team member adds on this lane, through the battles it lets a team reach. Based on your synced roster.
upgradeImpact.noTeams: Add a team to see which upgrades add points
upgradeImpact.noRows: No single next step adds points on this lane

points.label: Points
points.estimatedFallback: Estimated needs clear estimates, so Remaining is shown.
points.noProgress: No synced progress: Remaining shows every battle's points.
points.estimatedFallbackNoRoster: Estimated needs a synced roster, so Remaining is shown.

explanation.title: How points work
explanation.remaining: Remaining: the points still to score in every battle, leaving out what your synced progress has cleared.
explanation.all: All: points per battle (defeat-all plus the objectives the unit fits) times the lane's battles.
explanation.estimated: Estimated: Remaining, counted only within the battles the unit (or its teams) is expected to clear.
explanation.inTeams: In teams: a unit counts defeat-all plus only the objectives its teams on that lane cover; a reserve counts defeat-all only.

history.noTeams: No teams were planned for this run

since.title: Since last run
since.noSnapshot: Roster at the time is unavailable
since.none: No changes to these units since then

tierList.intro: Horde-mode tiers for every character, with the multiplier each one gets.
tierList.explainer: A character's multiplier scales its combat power in the Legendary Event clear estimates. Tiered characters use their own multiplier when they have one, otherwise their tier's; untiered characters use 1.0.
tierList.filtersDescription: Show only owned characters or one alliance.
tierList.untieredHint: Characters without a tier use 1.0×. Open the row to list them.

details.description: The character's tier, multiplier and owned state.
